explanation: A real bioRxiv preprint exists with this MSA BeadChip title/year and DOI 10.1101/2024.05.17.594606, but its authors are Goldberg, Cloud, Lee, Barnes, and others, not Kaur D et al. The claimed author appears to be mismatched with a different DNA methylation BeadChip paper.
mismatches: authors: claimed first author Kaur D, actual first author David C. Goldberg
title: claimed shortened title, actual title includes 'for high-throughput trait association studies'
search_attempts: web searched: "MSA: scalable DNA methylation screening BeadChip"
